name: Baraat ghodi
description: A white baraat horse, dressed in its wedding finery, gallops across the page with its legs really moving, then the invite appears.

name: Elephant procession
description: Two decorated elephants walk in from either side, meet below your text and raise their trunks in welcome.

name: Peacock dance
description: A peacock fans its tail open feather by feather beneath your words.

name: Rose petals
description: Painted rose petals tumble down the page while your text rises in.

name: Marigold garlands
description: Strings of marigolds drop from the top of the page and sway, the classic Haldi and mandap look.

name: Diya lights
description: A row of clay diyas rises in under your text and the lamps light up one by one.

name: Swinging lanterns
description: Brass lanterns drop in on chains and swing gently, glowing.

name: Sky lanterns
description: Glowing sky lanterns rise from below and drift up past your text.

name: Palace doors
description: Carved palace doors cover the page, then swing open to reveal your invite.

name: Lotus bloom
description: A lotus bud rises from the water and opens, with ripples and floating leaves.

name: Kalash blessing
description: A brass kalash rises in a golden glow while marigolds drift down: a blessing to open the invite.

name: Mehendi
description: A henna mandala draws itself in behind your text, line by line.

name: Parrots
description: Green parrots fly across the page, wings beating.

name: Butterflies
description: Butterflies flutter in and settle around your text.

name: Golden sparkles
description: Soft gold fireworks burst above your text and twinkle around it.

name: Floating clouds
description: Soft, see-through clouds drift slowly across the sky above and below your words, never over them.
